text: Rejected. E0003 (n=200, seed 1): accuracy 0.21 against the recorded answers, prediction >=0.98 refuted. E0004 (n=500, seed 2): 0.218, pre-registered replication confirmed. Chance for 5 symbols is 0.20. Mean logit difference is ~0 relative to its spread (2.06 and -4.23, std ~53) and the same on corrupt inputs (0.05, -4.52). The loaded model does not perform the behaviour.

Baseline at chance on two independent samples (0.21 on 200, 0.218 on 500; local-full, full precision). The logit difference correct-vs-incorrect is indistinguishable between clean and corrupt inputs. There is no behaviour in this checkpoint to explain.

Side observation, NOT a claim about this model: in the 64 labelled examples of E0001 the recorded answers fit a lookup rule (the last token selects one of positions 1-3, and the answer is a table lookup on last token and the selected token: last=ko reads pos 1, last=ni reads pos 3, last=fu/pa/tu read pos 2). This describes the dataset labels only; it was fitted by eye on 64 examples, never tested on held-out data, and the loaded model disagrees with those labels ~79% of the time (E0003, E0004), so it is not the model's function. The attribution screen E0002 (exploratory) is uninterpretable: estimates of -28 to -64 against a clean-corrupt gap of 2.0.

Stop per protocol step 1: the model does not do the behaviour, so no circuit search, no predict() and no verify_hypothesis. Naming heads or MLPs here would be a false discovery. 4 of 25 experiments used. Write the report as a null result.
